C9000295.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 295 (The Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture.; papers: Vanishing of higher bounded Hochschild cohomology; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/295.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN.statement: Manuscript thm:main: ordinary bounded self-coefficient Hochschild cohomology vanishes in degrees at least two for every complex von Neumann algebra.

C_NORMAL_REDUCTION.statement: Classical normal-cohomology and non-II_1 reductions used by the manuscript.

C_CENTRAL.statement: Central homotopy correction and assembly of uniformly bounded tracial primitives.

C_PRIMITIVE.statement: Averaging and the Liouville property give tracial bounded primitives with a uniform norm bound.

C_LIOUVILLE.statement: Manuscript thm:liouville for bounded-ball 2-continuous bounded harmonic maps.

C_WALK.statement: The walk construction produces asymptotically free independent products.

C_POPA.statement: Popa Theorem 0.1(a) supplies the II_1 factor-ultrapower freeness specialization, with its coordinate nonintertwining hypothesis.

C_RIGIDITY.statement: Under exactly the hypotheses of thm:rigidity, the two arbitrary left multipliers a and b agree.
C_RIGIDITY.remaining_obligation: Independent review of the analytic proof and statement fidelity.

C_ULTRAPOWER.statement: Bounded-ball 2-continuity is a uniform modulus and transfers to the bounded coordinatewise map on a finite tracial ultrapower.

C_LENGTH.statement: The free-word length-q operator norm is at most (q+1) times its coefficient l2 norm, including transfer to arbitrary faithfully tracial containing algebras.

C_BLOCK_CORE.statement: Universal free-reduction sign invariance, coverage and counting of all reduction fibers by insertion histories, and a uniform signed repeated-label bound.
C_BLOCK_CORE.remaining_obligation: Independent statement-fidelity review; no analytic theorem is encoded in Lean.

C_COEFFICIENT.statement: For every degree L ordered block product, every reduced length-q coefficient is bounded by 3^L r^(-q/2), and repeated surviving labels contribute an operator-norm error O_L(r^(-1/2)).

C_BLOCKS.statement: In the tracial ultrapower, S(P(s))=aP(s) and S(P(s)^*)=bP(s)^* for every ordered block product P.

C_POLAR.statement: The normalized-sum ultrapower limit has a unitary polar part V, and the block identities transfer to all positive and negative powers of V.

C_UNITARY.statement: In any finite faithfully tracial von Neumann algebra, bounded complex-linear S with S(V^k)=aV^k and S(V^(-k))=bV^(-k) for all k>=1 forces a=b without commutation or continuity assumptions.

C_CATALAN.statement: All moments of s*s are Catalan; its spectral measure is the explicitly computed compactly supported density with no atom at zero.

C_QUANTITATIVE_UNITARY.statement: For arbitrary unitary V and bounded complex-linear S in a finite faithfully tracial algebra, the harmonic-weighted power defects D_m imply ||a-b||_2 <= [B(2||S||+||a||+||b||)+D_m]/[cos(1)h_m] for every m>=1, B=1+pi.

C_SIGN_LANGUAGE_RIGIDITY.statement: The original rigidity conclusion still holds when prescriptions are required only on distinct-index positive-ended words without consecutive negatives and on their adjoints.
